item.title: Serbia’s Longtime President Aleksandar Vucic Resigns Post
item.description: Vučić not allowed to seek third presidential term and election will test his grip on rule after widespread protests Serbia’s populist president, Aleksandar Vučić, has resigned to pursue an attempt to become prime minister in an early parliamentary election that will test his firm rule in the Balkan country after nearly two years of protests. Vučić’s second presidential term would otherwise end in May next year. He is banned by the constitution from seeking a third term and said he was resigning to lead his rightwing Serbian Progressive party (SNS) in the 25 October ballot. Continue reading... item.title: In 1993, a project set out to reconnect wildlife habitat from Yellowstone to Canada's Yukon
item.description: The Yellowstone to Yukon Conservation Initiative is proudly nominated for Prince William's Earthshot Prize in 2026. This groundbreaking effort aims to reinstate a vital 3,400-kilometre wildlife corridor through the majestic Rocky Mountains. Achieving over 200 wildlife crossings and safeguarding around 24 million hectares, Indigenous involvement is key to strengthening conservation practices here. Looking forward, the initiative hopes to secure an extra 20 million hectares by 2030. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: California state officials secured 640 acres of desert land near Pioneertown for western Joshua tree conservation. Collaboration with Native American tribes is planned for long-term stewardship of the property. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
